messages:
maya: getting multiple customer reports of 5xx/timeouts on hosted endpoints since ~11:02 UTC. examples: POST /v1/generate returning 502, embeddings 504. sample x-request-id: abc123def. not a single customer, traffic-wide spike.
support-bot: ALERT: 5xx-rate up (60m): +420% — threshold breached for hosted-api-prod — incident created #inc-171523.
olivia: thanks @maya — checking infra metrics now. grabbing memcached/redis metrics for prefix-cache.
raj: looking at memcached cluster: connection rejects and increased evictions starting 11:00. logs show repeated "accept failed: errno 111" and "out of memory" on node memcached-2.
jordan: which routes are most affected? do we have quick curl repro?
maya: repro with: curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' — it hangs ~10s then 502. headers: x-cache-status: MISS, x-upstream-timeout: true.
olivia: memcached keys being used are prefix:<model>:<user-id>:<prompt-hash>. after last model rollout we saw key cardinality jump 8x. likely key explosion causing thrash and OOM.
raj: mitigation idea: temporarily fail-open the prefix cache so requests go to model runtime backend instead of trying memcached. can also bump memcached memory and restart node.
jordan: how to fail-open quickly? is there a runtime flag?
raj: yes — set CONFIG_PREFIX_CACHE_ENABLED=false on gateway pods or flip route config in control plane to bypass prefix cache for hosted-api. command: kubectl set env deployment/gateway -n hosted CONFIG_PREFIX_CACHE_ENABLED=false && kubectl rollout restart deployment/gateway -n hosted
olivia: I'll coordinate the config flip. also increasing memcached memory is longer path. will queue a rolling restart for memcached-2 after config flip.
maya: done — flipped cache to fail-open at 11:10 UTC. immediate observation: error rate dropped ~65% within 2 minutes. some latency increase but overall success rate improved.
sre-bot: Deploy event: gateway env change applied by olivia at 2024-05-08T11:10Z — rollout succeeded.
support-bot: Customer-facing update: please send standard acknowledgement to affected customers, referencing transient cache outage and mitigation.
jordan: root cause hypothesis: model rollout increased prefix diversity -> huge cache key set -> memcached memory pressure -> rejects/timeouts -> gateway dependency timed out causing 5xx. long-term fixes: key normalization + TTLs + circuit-breaker + autoscaling memcached or sharding.
olivia: action items: (1) postmortem in incidents channel with timeline, (2) add a gateway circuit-breaker to fail-open automatically when memcached error rate > X%, (3) normalize keys for user-scoped prefixes, (4) increase memcached memory and add pod anti-affinity, (5) add alert for eviction rate > Y. I'll create tickets.
maya: customers responded: a few say degradation resolved, one still saw an error at 11:12 — offered credit.
raj: restarted memcached-2 at 11:16; node came back healthy at 11:18. metrics now stable.
maya: marking this thread resolved for support; moving full write-up to #inc-171523 and will do postmortem. thanks all. :thumbsup:
